overall.reason: Zero of five components satisfies the no-Docker/no-user-runtime executable-start contract. next/agent_service lack a bundled or embedded Node executable in the proof layout; fastapi lacks any bundled Python; postgres_pgvector and vector_store are Docker-image-only. Phase 42-45 execution readiness is therefore blocked (D-41-06).
failedPrerequisites: PREREQ-1 Bundled Node executable: prove server.js (next) and start.mjs (agent_service) start from a bundled/embedded Node binary inside the resource tree (e.g. Electron embedded Node v24.18.1 via ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1, or a packaged node.exe) with loopback readiness and owned shutdown. Today every recorded start resolves system node; electron dist binary is absent from the proof layout.

PREREQ-2 Bundled Python for FastAPI: prove a relocatable/standalone Python runtime under the resource root runs uvicorn + backend deps + alembic migrations with writable data under %APPDATA%/NovelMind. The dev venv depends on user-installed Python 3.13.12.

PREREQ-3 PostgreSQL 16 + pgvector Windows-native distribution: replace the Docker image with a Windows-native bundled distribution and prove init/start/readiness/shutdown on a loopback port. pgvector Windows build/redistribution is unproven.

PREREQ-4 Vector store bundling: decide embedded mode (chromadb python library inside the bundled FastAPI venv) or a bundled Chroma server, and prove start/readiness/shutdown. Only the Docker image exists today.

PREREQ-5 Licensing/redistribution: record and bundle redistribution rights for torch/sentence-transformers/litellm (FastAPI AI path), the pgvector extension distribution, Chroma, and @earendil-works/pi-* agent packages; each bundled runtime needs an explicit license/redistribution note.

PREREQ-6 Packaged writable-path operation: exercise %APPDATA%/NovelMind writable layout (logs, data, sqlite, pgdata, chroma) so the mutable-data row is proven, not just declared by the topology contract.
overall.replanningBoundary: NO-GO may revise packaging internals (per-component bundling adapters, runtime distribution sources, embedded-vs-server vector choice) in a revised 41-03 replan. It must NOT: (a) expand into a broad UI rewrite, (b) weaken the no-Docker/no-user-runtime contract (D-41-04), (c) reduce the 13-route coverage already proven (D-41-02), or (d) alter Phase 22's independent 0/3 blocked verdict. Evidence-hash tampering or an absent mandatory row deterministically forces NO-GO (T-41-03-01); the decision records commands, versions, fixture and timestamp (T-41-03-02).
